cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember my lesson about spending on what you use? Sell the signed guitar and we can replace our fridge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I queued all night for that signature. I can't sell that night.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're separating an experience from an object. The night stays yours; the guitar can buy us cold milk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sell the case. I wrote the date of the concert inside it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the case, then. You're finally spotting what matters. Let me photograph the guitar without it.

reason: Make A opportunistically teach a distinction between memory and saleable object; B dated case lets A reverse its compromise toward surrendering the guitar.
